title: Elodie and the Extraction
author: Ines Reyes
blurb: Hazel Nakamura, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
